title: Smiling Toddler on Brick Steps, 1949 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photograph taken in March 1949 capturing a three-year-old child sitting on the bottom of a set of brick steps outside a residential home. The toddler wears a dark winter coat and light-colored shoes, smiling towards the camera. The background features a brick facade, wooden doorway, and bare early spring branches.
